correctness.rationale: The proof dichotomy is valid. A singleton occupied target level contracts the image by two pointwise comparisons. If no occupied level is a singleton, each binary source level must map to two distinct points of one target level, and these target levels strictly increase with source level. Thus h>k is impossible in this branch, while h<k leaves an omitted target level whose point gives a comparable contraction of the image inclusion. Independent recomputation of the exact Git tree confirmed the assigned source snapshot, and the transparent finite checker is consistent with the symbolic proof but is not used to prove all heights.
